t: You're looking at the Waithman Memorial, a memorial in London to Robert Waithman. He was a master draper who later became a politician, a reforming Whig from an industrial background. The Corporation of London made him an alderman and then elected him Lord Mayor for the usual ceremonial year. The memorial was designed by James Elmes, an English architect, civil engineer and writer on the arts. It stands as a public tribute to a tradesman who rose to the city's highest civic office.
